summary.text: On Tarkir, the clans wage a conflict for supremacy over the plane that spans a thousand years.
The story follows Sarkhan Vol, who uses Ugin's Nexus to travel 1,280 years back in time and rescue the dragon Ugin from Nicol Bolas, changing the time stream.
Where Bolas's killing of Ugin once let the clans hunt Tarkir's dragons to extinction, the new timeline revives the dragons and each clan surrenders to the dragonlords.
